entries.13960dec114600fd: It holds industry seminars specializing in science and engineering several times a year in major cities such as Tokyo and Osaka, providing opportunities to match mainly students from regional science and engineering universities with companies headquartered in major cities, and receives exhibition fees from companies. When it is contracted to run job-hunting events conducted by individual universities, it receives operating fees from the universities. It also holds career exchange meetings open only to female science and engineering students.
entries.1716fdb6a90ff67d: A business provided by the company and its consolidated subsidiary Adowiru Co., Ltd.
entries.1a56cb05d8ea83b6: A service that provides year-round support for hiring kōsen students, centered on recruitment consulting, including accompanying (on behalf of companies) school visits and planning and support for internships and open company events.
entries.2a88db028b83a3db: Engaged in a career support business that supports job hunting by students, mainly students of technical colleges (kosen), and recruitment by companies, and in producing WEB sites and videos for corporate clients.
entries.3b01cb20d1f8840e: It operates the WEB media “Gekkan Kōsen,” which disseminates information on the characteristics of technical colleges nationwide, the specialist subjects of their teachers, presentations of kōsen students’ research results, and the achievements of kōsen alumni.
entries.5b24d0c47b78404b: It operates the WEB media “Gekkan Kōsen,” which disseminates information on the characteristics of technical colleges nationwide, the specialist subjects of their teachers, presentations of kōsen students’ research results, and the achievements of kōsen alumni. In addition to producing a “Daigakubetsu Shūkatsu Techō” for each university under contract from universities nationwide, it publishes the official guidebook “Kōsen-sei no Tame no Shigoto Kenkyū Seminar Kōshiki Gaidobukku,” which is distributed to technical colleges nationwide ahead of company-hosted events, and receives advertising fees from exhibiting companies and others.
entries.82776b62005a1886: Company-hosted events include the “Kōsen-sei no Tame no Shigoto Kenkyū Seminar,” held in 7 regions nationwide, seminars for the civil engineering and construction industry, the “Kokusaku Sangyō Shigoto Kenkyū Seminar,” focused on the semiconductor and defense industries, and the online “Kōsen Internship Kenkyū Seminar” and “KOSEN meetup company.”
entries.88d3ab254e0892ea: A business provided by the company. It mainly holds job-hunting events for science and engineering students, centered on kōsen students, operates the career information site “Kōsen Purasu,” and provides recruitment consulting services, among others. There are two types of events: those hosted by the company and those hosted by schools and contracted out to the company; the company receives exhibition fees (sponsorship fees) from exhibiting companies and contract fees for operation from schools. Revenue for the fiscal year ended July 2026 was ¥1,373 million.
entries.94e4029a3cfd3293: A business provided by the company and its consolidated subsidiary Adowiru Co., Ltd. Targeting corporate clients, it contracts WEB site production, WEB site maintenance support, video production and DTP production, among others. From recruitment PR support, starting with production of new-graduate recruitment sites, to recruitment branding, corporate site production and corporate branding, it plans and produces WEB content and various PR tools tailored to clients’ objectives and issues. Revenue for the fiscal year ended July 2026 was ¥260 million.
entries.952f488b7355590d: A business provided by the company.
entries.981cb7827534696d: Company-hosted events include the “Kōsen-sei no Tame no Shigoto Kenkyū Seminar,” held in 7 regions nationwide, seminars for the civil engineering and construction industry, the “Kokusaku Sangyō Shigoto Kenkyū Seminar,” focused on the semiconductor and defense industries, and the online “Kōsen Internship Kenkyū Seminar” and “KOSEN meetup company.” Kōsen students sometimes take part as part of school events or classes, and a high participation rate is a feature because the company group arranges transportation, including bookings with travel agencies. In school-hosted contract events, it contracts the planning, operation and implementation of joint on-campus company information sessions at each technical college (kōsen) and PBL (problem-based learning), among others.
entries.9a15ce29a9a782d6: It holds industry seminars specializing in science and engineering several times a year in major cities such as Tokyo and Osaka, providing opportunities to match mainly students from regional science and engineering universities with companies headquartered in major cities, and receives exhibition fees from companies.
entries.e6cc9d6beecedce4: WEB media “Gekkan Kōsen,” Daigakubetsu Shūkatsu Techō (university job-hunting planners) and official guidebook
entries.e9135869d68907d7: A career support information site linked to the company-hosted job-hunting events for kōsen students.
entries.eb2581cd39b1aaa5: A service that provides year-round support for hiring kōsen students, centered on recruitment consulting, including accompanying (on behalf of companies) school visits and planning and support for internships and open company events. Using know-how and data accumulated by the company group in career support, it provides recruitment support tailored to each company’s situation and needs.
entries.ff45cb5a58800916: A career support information site linked to the company-hosted job-hunting events for kōsen students. In addition to providing high-quality job information to students, it also provides further education information, including transfers to universities and advancement to graduate schools.
